rationale: Affected baseline items: 14 of 18. Reconciliation counts: 18 reconciled once—2 artifact/not_applicable, 5 exact_match/verified, 10 normalized_match/accurately_unavailable, and 1 exact_match/accurately_unavailable. The effective outcome remains discrepancy_found. Luna missed current menu scope, while Terra correctly rejected complete arrays and negatives from incomplete allergen coverage but over-corrected several explicit positives. Restaurant-issued wording preserves contains-gluten evidence for the six named fried items, contains-soy evidence for tenders/bites, and ingredient or unavoidable-identity positives such as milk in mozzarella sticks and cheese-bearing Hot Honey Pepperoni. Cross-contact warnings must remain separate.
